fixtures.provenance: All adversarial fixtures are SYNTHETIC, built locally with ffmpeg from the committed dev bundle clip wm-volley-02. Held-out cases (wm-dink-01, afn-vic-rally1) were never touched.

cases.case: slideshow of pickleball still photos (1s per photo)
cases.beforeFix: PASSED THROUGH via median inter-frame diff only for crossfade variant; hard-cut slideshow was caught
cases.afterFix: REJECTED (still_image_video via frozen-pair fraction >= 0.5 at pair diff <= 0.02)

cases.case: crossfading slideshow of pickleball still photos
cases.beforeFix: PASSED THROUGH (median diff above old still threshold)

cases.case: TV broadcast with static score-graphic overlay
cases.afterFix: REJECTED (static_overlay_suspected: frozen bottom-third connected component, size >= 8 px at 64x36, luma std >= 12)

cases.case: video of a phone screen playing pickleball (dark static bezel)
cases.afterFix: REJECTED (static_border_frame: 2-px border ring temporal std <= 1 and mean luma <= 48)

STILL PASSES THROUGH. No reliable CPU-only frame-statistic discriminator was found that does not also reject legitimate high-motion footage. Honestly surfaced: 'playback_speed' is listed in report.notEvaluated.

fixes.contract: frame-analyzability re-versioned frame-analyzability-1 -> frame-analyzability-2 (new reason codes static_border_frame, static_overlay_suspected; still_image_video semantics changed to frozen-pair fraction). usable-result-v1 and silent-failure-v1 untouched.
mechanisms: frozen-pair fraction still-image detection (pair diff <= 0.02, fraction >= 0.5) replacing median-diff threshold
per-pixel temporal mean/std accumulation at 64x36 enabling border-ring and bottom-third frozen-component measurements

negativeCorpusDelta.change: 5 real negatives (yt--wE27MoX2AM-tennis, yt-RpPe0h9cD5E-tennis, yt-Iw55LinAF0U-badminton, yt-zWQs7kTKcEY-emptycourt, ia-HanfordS1957-titlecard) previously rejected by the median inter-frame-diff still_image_video rule now pass the pose-free gate.
negativeCorpusDelta.justification: That old rule was blanket abstention, not detection: it also rejected 5/6 legitimate fresh-candidate pickleball clips (median diffs overlap: negatives 0.085-0.419 vs legitimate footage 0.095-0.777). No CPU-only frame statistic separates other-racket-sport/low-motion real footage from legitimate pickleball; that discrimination is content/pose-level (macOS). Test expectations were re-measured and updated with this documented rationale; d08-ood-measurements.json (another workstream's artifact) was left untouched.
negativeCorpusDelta.status: OPEN (pose-free gate insufficient for these real negatives; pose-conditioned signals on macOS remain the intended catch)
